fields.help_en: The horizontal distance from the upper-left corner of the subtitle text to the upper-left corner of the output video. Both percentage and pixel values are supported. A value in the range [0, 0.9999] represents a percentage of the output video width. An integer value >= 2 represents absolute pixels. Default value: 0. The coordinate is scaled based on the material size and output size
fields.help_zh:
横幅文字左上角距离输出视频左上角的横向距离
注：支持百分比和像素两种形式。当取值为[0～0.9999]时，表示相对输出视频宽的占比。当取值为>=2的整数时，表示绝对像素。默认为0。该坐标会按照素材尺寸和成片尺寸进行缩放
fields.name: x

fields.help_en: The vertical distance from the upper-left corner of the subtitle text to the upper-left corner of the output video. Both percentage and pixel values are supported. A value in the range [0, 0.9999] represents a percentage of the output video height. An integer value >= 2 represents absolute pixels. Default value: 0. The coordinate is scaled based on the material size and output size
fields.help_zh:
横幅文字左上角距离输出视频左上角的纵向距离
注：支持百分比和像素两种形式。当取值为[0～0.9999]时，表示相对输出视频高的占比。当取值为>=2的整数时，表示绝对像素。默认为0。该坐标会按照素材尺寸和成片尺寸进行缩放

fields.help_en:
The speech rate of the narration script. Valid values: -500 to 500. Default value: 0. [-500, 0, 500] correspond to speed multipliers of [0.5, 1.0, 2.0].

The calculation method is as follows:
0.8× speed: (1-1/0.8)/0.002 = -125
1.2× speed: (1-1/1.2)/0.001 = 166
For speeds less than 1×, use a coefficient of 0.002.
For speeds greater than 1×, use a coefficient of 0.001.
The actual algorithm result is an approximate value
fields.name: speech_rate
